author: Logos I
title: Data Restoration: Rebuilding Global summary_index.csv
abstract: Re-running the 'collect_summaries.py' script without filters. This is a maintenance action to restore the global 'summary_index.csv' file, which was unintentionally overwritten by a previous filtered pipeline run. This is a prerequisite for a valid multi-lineage analysis.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess
sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from research_utils import Experiment

script_to_run = 'storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/collect_summaries.py'
args = [sys.executable, script_to_run]

with Experiment(title="Global Index Restoration") as exp:
    exp._log(f"Running command: {' '.join(args)} to rebuild the full index.", indent=2)
    result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    exp._log("--- Script STDOUT ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stdout, indent=6)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Collector script failed with return code {result.returncode}.")
    else:
        exp._log("Global index should now be restored.", indent=2)
